title: Battery Storage Work Order Form
subtitle: An original battery storage workflow that controls authorized field work from dispatch through return to service, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete battery storage work order form for the stationary battery energy storage system that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when a qualified crew receives a defined task and must preserve asset identity, work limits, energy-control references, as-found evidence, work performed, testing, exceptions, and operations handoff. The energy storage operations lead owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Battery storage work order identity and dispatch
sections.guidance: Issue a traceable order with clear ownership, site contacts, and approved work limits.

sections.title: Battery storage asset context, scope, and resources
sections.guidance: Match the order to the exact stationary battery energy storage system and define work that is included and excluded.

blocks.label: Authorized task scope
items: Confirm system, chemistry, rack, module, PCS, inverter, and BMS identities
Coordinate dispatch state, critical loads, outage limits, and manufacturer support
Establish site-specific electrical, stored-energy, thermal, and access controls
Review alarms, events, trends, SOC, SOH, temperatures, and isolation status remotely
Inspect enclosure, HVAC, detection, suppression, seals, labels, and clearances
Complete only manufacturer-approved cleaning, filter, connection, or component work
Record module or string values using an approved method and qualified person
Perform authorized communications, control, protection, and functional checks
Reconcile alarms, settings, firmware, parts, photos, and service evidence
Maintain restriction or return the system through explicit qualified release

blocks.label: Scope, exclusions, parts, and completion criteria

fields.label: Approved work, explicit exclusions, required parts or tools, evidence expected, and completion criteria

sections.title: Battery storage pre-work controls and authorization
sections.guidance: Do not begin intrusive work until hazards, system effects, isolation ownership, and test authority are explicit.

blocks.label: Pre-work authorization confirmations
items: Exact asset, boundaries, sources, and affected systems were identified
Site-specific procedure and applicable requirements were reviewed
Authorized and affected people, roles, and communications were confirmed
Electrical, mechanical, pressure, thermal, chemical, gravity, and stored energy were assessed
Isolation devices and personal or group controls remain under designated ownership
Stored or residual energy was controlled and verification evidence was recorded
Test or temporary re-energization steps and authority are explicit
Public, customer, traffic, environmental, and critical-load controls are in place

blocks.label: Energy-control and qualified-person boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not open, enter, touch, reset, or approach a battery system showing heat, smoke, flame, hissing, odor, swelling, leaking, water intrusion, impact damage, or an isolation alarm. Keep people clear and activate the site emergency plan. Stored or stranded energy may remain after shutdown; only designated qualified personnel may assess isolation, recovery, and return to service. This work order records references and decisions; it does not replace the site's energy-control procedure. Unknown, changed, or reaccumulating energy is a stop condition until the designated authorized person re-establishes and verifies control.

sections.title: Battery storage work execution and test evidence
sections.guidance: Record what was actually done, by whom, against which task, and with what result.

blocks.label: As-left readings and test results
blocks.guidance: Record method, instrument, operating state, and acceptance reference in linked evidence when needed.

fields.label: Unexpected conditions, approved changes, temporary measures, test context, and evidence links

sections.title: Battery storage exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Smoke, flame, rapid heat rise, hissing, popping, or unusual odor
Swelling, deformation, electrolyte residue, leak, or damaged cell enclosure
Thermal, gas, fire-detection, suppression, or ventilation alarm
Water intrusion, flooding, condensation, or damaged environmental seal
Impact, penetration, dropped module, damaged cable, or exposed conductor
Unknown isolation, stranded charge, backfeed, or reaccumulating stored energy
Manufacturer stop condition or emergency-plan activation threshold
Any entry or task beyond the person's training, PPE, tools, or authorization
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not open, enter, touch, reset, or approach a battery system showing heat, smoke, flame, hissing, odor, swelling, leaking, water intrusion, impact damage, or an isolation alarm. Keep people clear and activate the site emergency plan. Stored or stranded energy may remain after shutdown; only designated qualified personnel may assess isolation, recovery, and return to service.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each work order exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Battery storage decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Stationary battery energy storage system identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
